# Fifth Element

> Fifth Element is a US-based franchise marketing agency serving franchisors, multi-unit operators, and individual franchisees. We build hyper-local lead engines for franchise brands across fitness, salon suites, wellness, beauty, home services, and lifestyle verticals. Founded and led by Tristynn McGowan. Based in Murrieta, California. Phone (951) 618-1304.

## What We Do

Fifth Element delivers a complete franchise marketing system built around three pillars:

1. **Predictable Local Lead Flow** — Centralized Meta and Google ad management with hyper-local campaigns per franchise location.
2. **UGC-Powered Creative Engine** — Authentic content from real franchisees that outperforms corporate stock creative by 30-50% on cost per lead.
3. **5E Insight Engine** — AI-driven dashboards showing real-time performance across every location.

## Services

- [Franchise Paid Ads Management](https://5them.com/paid-ads): Meta and Google Ads management for multi-location brands.
- [Social Media & Creative Production](https://5them.com/creative-production): UGC creative briefing, production, editing, and deployment.
- [CRM & Marketing Automation](https://5them.com/crm-automations): Speed-to-lead workflows and pipeline automation on GoHighLevel.
- [Email & SMS Marketing](https://5them.com/email-sms): Automated follow-up sequences for franchise locations.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://5them.com/reporting-and-analytics): Real-time multi-location performance dashboards.
- [Franchise Growth Systems](https://5them.com/franchise-growth-systems): The integrated full-stack franchise marketing engine.

## Industries Served

- [Fitness Franchises](https://5them.com/fitness-franchises): EMS, Pilates, HIIT, yoga, CrossFit, stretch and recovery.
- [Salon Suites](https://5them.com/salon-suites): Hair, nails, barbershop, beauty professionals.
- [Wellness & Recovery](https://5them.com/wellness-franchises): Cryotherapy, light therapy, IV, med spa.
- [Beauty & Aesthetics](https://5them.com/beauty-aesthetics): Lashes, skincare, cosmetic services.
- [Home Services](https://5them.com/home-services): HVAC, plumbing, restoration, cleaning, landscaping.
- [Lifestyle & Entertainment](https://5them.com/lifestyle-entertainment): Golf, recreation, experiential concepts.

## Audiences

- [For Franchisors](https://5them.com/for-franchisors): CEOs, CMOs, and VP Marketing leading franchise systems.
- [For Franchisees](https://5them.com/for-franchisees): Single-location and multi-unit operators.

## Free Audit Offer

Fifth Element offers a Free Franchise Lead Engine Audit: a 45-minute Zoom call where the team screen-shares your existing ad accounts and identifies at least 3 specific improvements. If we cannot find 3 improvements, we send you a $100 gift card. No pitch unless asked. Book at https://go.5them.com/free-franchise-lead-engine-audit.
